# Vendored frontend assets

Nothing in this directory is loaded from a CDN at runtime. Files are
downloaded once, committed, and served from `/static/vendor/`.

| File | Source | Version | Fetched |
|---|---|---|---|
| pico.min.css | https://picocss.com (npm @picocss/pico) | 2.1.1 | 2026-09-28 |
| htmx.min.js | https://htmx.org (npm htmx.org) | 2.0.11 | 2026-09-28 |
| Sortable.min.js | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@1.15.7/Sortable.min.js (npm sortablejs) | 1.15.7 | 2026-10-11 |
